aggregation.error: ERROR при неоднозначной/неполной population или ошибке наблюдения.
aggregation.fail: VALUE/FAIL, если хотя бы один включённый regular file имеет mode bits 0022.
aggregation.pass: VALUE/PASS, если population полностью определена и violations=0; пустая population также PASS.

comparison.rule: Для каждого включённого regular file требуется (mode & 0022) == 0, что точно соответствует chmod go-w.

donor_precedent: Pinned engineering donor parent root /var/spool/cron is not retained in the current source population: on supported Ubuntu/Debian cron, per-user crontab files are stored directly in /var/spool/cron/crontabs. v2 scans only that canonical user-crontab root and fails closed on observation ambiguity.
evidence_scope: Эти VM-наблюдения подтверждают layout/population assumptions SRC-0011, но сами по себе не расширяют current product target за пределы ubuntu-24.04-x86_64.

population.directories: Directory entries below /var/spool/cron/crontabs are outside the direct per-user crontab-file population and are not recursively traversed.
population.empty: Если canonical root /var/spool/cron/crontabs отсутствует либо direct regular files не найдены, population считается пустой и compliant.
population.enumeration: Only direct regular non-symlink files (maxdepth 1) of /var/spool/cron/crontabs are included. The parent /var/spool/cron is not a population root, so unrelated sibling/direct objects and atd spools cannot be misclassified as user crontabs.
population.errors: Любая ошибка traversal/stat делает результат ERROR; partial PASS запрещён.
population.overlap: Not applicable: current canonical population has one root.
population.root_role: Canonical discovery root /var/spool/cron/crontabs; the root directory itself is not a checked object.
population.special: A special object directly inside an admitted root gives ERROR; objects nested below non-population subdirectories are not traversed.
population.symlink: A symlink directly inside an admitted root or symlink instead of root gives ERROR; dereference is forbidden.
